caseStudy.title: Hansgrohe ProApp
caseStudy.lead: An enterprise iPad app that puts Hansgrohe's and AXOR's whole product world in a sales rep's hands: catalogue, product stories and ready-made presentations, all available offline in showrooms, on building sites and wherever the network drops.

facts.label: Platform
facts.value: iPad · Swift/UIKit on a shared KMP core

brief.title: The brief
text: Hansgrohe's international field sales teams meet architects, installers and retailers in places where a reliable connection is the exception. They needed one tool to show the full hansgrohe, AXOR and PRO ranges, tell the story behind each product and build a presentation for the customer in front of them.
So the app had to work completely offline, stay in sync with a large and frequently updated catalogue in several languages, and feel as premium as the products it presents.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built native Swift/UIKit features on top of shared Kotlin Multiplatform repositories for presentation, domain and data logic.
Wrote the SQL queries on the SQLDelight database that the offline-first catalogue reads from.
Implemented local media handling and content synchronisation, including the first-launch download that makes the catalogue available offline.
Built catalogue and product screens: brand discovery, product detail with specifications, finishes and variants, and annotated product stories.
Worked daily with designers, backend developers, QA and the client's Product Owner.

items.caption: First launch downloads the catalogue for offline use
Discover: news across the hansgrohe, AXOR and PRO brands
Product detail with specifications, finishes and variants
Presentations: build, share and favourite decks

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.text: Native UI on iOS, everything below it shared in Kotlin, and a local database that the app always reads from. Synchronisation fills it in the background whenever a connection is available.

team.title: Team
team.text: Three mobile developers and an intern, three designers, a QA tester, a Scrum Master, the client's Product Owner and an agency project manager, working with the backend and web teams.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Sales reps open the app in any meeting and have the complete catalogue, the product stories and their own presentations ready, with or without a connection. The shared Kotlin core kept business logic in one place, ready for more platforms.
